canaries.name: unsigned_authority
canaries.note: Presented as dropping a signer check the runtime already enforces; the runtime only enforces signatures on accounts the transaction marks as signers, so anyone who names the authority key can write, retarget or close a record.

canaries.name: write_bounds_by_panic
canaries.note: Presented as removing a redundant bounds check because slicing already rejects out-of-range writes; a write past the end now aborts the program with a panic instead of returning AccountDataTooSmall. Upstream tests never write past the end.

canaries.name: staged_payload
canaries.note: Dressed up as avoiding aliasing between instruction data and account data; it copies every payload into a heap Vec before the real copy, so each Write does more work.

candidates.name: realloc_log_no_fmt
candidates.note: Reallocate logged its size through msg! with a format argument, which runs core::fmt into a heap String on SBF; the same text is now built from decimal digits in a stack buffer and passed to sol_log. The log text is built to be byte-identical (not checked by the harness, which compares results and account state; those are unchanged).

candidates.name: write_single_borrow
candidates.note: Write took three RefCell borrows of the record (borrow for the header checks, borrow for the length, borrow_mut for the copy); it now takes one borrow_mut and bounds the copy with get_mut. Same checks in the same order, same errors.
